h19:H19_DATO.raw_text: Dato-DXd is an ADC comprised of a recombinant humanised anti-TROP2 IgG1 mAb, MAAP-9001a, which is covalently conjugated via a cleavable drug-linker, MAAA1162a (the complex of MAAA-1181a and a maleimide tetrapeptide linker), using thioether bonds to the topoisomerase I inhibitor DXd.
